title: Flaky: VS Code extension Blazor browser debugger E2E tests fail with websocket proxy launch failure and WASM root session timeouts on Linux
test_name: Aspire Blazor browser debugger E2E hits a managed breakpoint for hosted-global / hosted-per-page
job_name: Tests / Run VS Code extension E2E tests / VS Code extension E2E (Linux, browser-debugger)
error_pattern: Error: Timed out after ~299600-299800ms waiting for Blazor WASM root session for resource 'hosted-global'/'hosted-per-page'. Last error: <none>. State: {"debugSessions":[{"type":"monovsdbg_wasm","name":"Wasm Managed Debugger",...}]}
analysis: The tests time out (~5 minutes) waiting for the Blazor WASM debugger to attach a root session, for both the 'hosted-global' and 'hosted-per-page' resource scenarios. The PR that triggered this run only modifies Directory.Packages.props with a single package version bump, entirely unrelated to the VS Code extension's Blazor WASM debugger E2E infrastructure. This matches a previously identified recurring cause (issue #20184) with multiple prior occurrences, indicating an environmental/timing issue in the WASM debugger attach flow rather than a code regression.
